title: He said 'I'll avenge you' — and he actually did
caption:
POV: your duo actually avenges your death
She rages over a 'YOU HAVE BEEN SLAIN' screen, he mutters 'I'll avenge you,' then lands a full combo, a double kill, and a VICTORY screen.
That one teammate who turns your worst game into a win — pure duo goals.
Tag the friend who always avenges your deaths — or are you the one getting avenged?
Save this for your next duo session and follow @fruit_drama_tv for more mini gaming dramas.
